label: 1.1.0 正式版
notes: 新增：药水可在战斗中使用了（之前买了用不掉，bug）
新增：战斗音效（程序化生成，10 种，零版权）
新增：解锁系统（卡牌与勋章逐步开放）
新增：无尽模式每轮叠加「战场态势」
新增：每日挑战成绩记录与连续天数
新增：卡牌悬停大图预览
修复：英文模式大量卡牌/勋章/提示文案残留中文
notes_en: New: potions can now actually be used in battle (they were purchasable but unusable — a real bug)
New: battle sound effects (10 procedurally generated, zero copyright)
New: unlock system (cards and relics open up as you play)
New: Endless mode now stacks a Battlefield Condition each loop
New: daily challenge scores and streaks
Fix: lots of card/relic/tooltip text stayed Chinese in English mode
